compare_builds.description: See what a patch did to the cards: every card one game build added, every card it removed, and every card whose name, text, mana cost, attack, health, keywords, rarity, set or other playing details changed, each change written as before and after. Name the build to compare against, or leave it empty for the build just before, so a workflow that notices a new build with Get the latest build can post its balance changes in the next step. Reads two card files, one for each build. No API key required.

description: Read Hearthstone's card data from a workflow. HearthstoneJSON publishes every card in the game, converted straight out of the game files, in fourteen languages. Search the whole card pool by text and by set, class, type, rarity, minion type, spell school, keyword, mana cost, attack, health and Battlegrounds tavern tier; look one card up by name, ID or dbfId; pick one at random for a card of the day; and follow a card to the tokens, enchantments and hero power it brings with it. Break a slice of the pool down by every property at once, with its mana curve and its averages, to see what an expansion gave each class. Turn a deck code into its cards and a list of cards into a deck code, and see what a patch changed by comparing two game builds. Every card comes back with its rules text in plain readable form and its art, tile and full-card render already addressed, and any of those images can be downloaded and attached. The card sets, minion types, spell schools and keywords a step can filter on are read from the card data itself, so a new expansion needs no new setup. Every action reads: nothing here changes anything. No account or API key required.
